blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Filipino analog astronauts recently met with President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., who once dreamed of becoming an astronaut. During the meeting, Marcos vowed to support the country’s space program. The four Filipinos, who have participated in space simulation missions and training programs worldwide, shared their experiences and insights during a courtesy call on Thursday in Malacañang as Marcos “eagerly listened” to them, said the Presidential Communications Office.
